visualReview.method: Direct visual reading of every complete card image and enlarged rules panels. No OCR was run or consulted; no OCR cache was read.
visualReview.policy: Include dictionary keyword references in actual rules, including conditional and disabled effects. Exclude titles, italic flavor text, card-type footers, unrelated ordinary words, and fragments of differently defined boss-specific traits. Do not infer unprinted effects from keyword definitions. Reviews are bound to the exact local image SHA-256; replacement artwork requires a new review.
